review_modes: full-resolution inspection of UI and aircraft identity
playback at 1x and 0.5x around proposed joins

acceptance.entry: UI geometry, lettering, sky, illumination and motion match the source before 6.5s without a visible step.
acceptance.core: Citation push carries momentum into the same realistic plane; no braking/static far-shot reset.
acceptance.preservation: Close lateral pass and three-quarter rear departure retain aircraft geometry/livery, direction and usable timing.
acceptance.exit: Sky/plane motion remain coherent into following footage; no frozen sky or premature aircraft dissolve. Removal of post-flight lettering is expected, not a failure of pixel equality.
acceptance.scope: Pilot alone does not approve downstream clean sky/closing or whole-film continuity; inspect final assembly after all visual work.
acceptance.audio: Discard native model audio. Generate music and SFX only after approved full visual timing.
